statement.text:
Does every Lipschitz 4-manifold admit a smooth structure? Is this smooth structure unique if so? Some more specific, related questions are as follows.

(a) Is there a topological, spin, closed, indefinite 4-manifold X that admits a Lipschitz structure and violates the 10/8-inequality $b_{2}(X) \geq 5|\sigma(X)|$ +2 by Furuta [Fur01], or the “10/8+4” inequality $b_{2}(X) \geq 5|\sigma(X)|$ +4 by Hopkins–Lin–Shi–Xu [HLSX22] for $X \ne S^{4}, S^{2} \times S^{2}, K3$.

(b) Let $X \subset \mathbb{R}^{4}$ be a Lipschitz embedded 4-manifold with boundary $\partial X \cong S^{3}$. Does X admit a unique smooth structure?
